notes.title: New Killer UI + Inventory Loss Bug Fix
notes.content:
New Killer UI that shows how much damage each player has taken, which are ready to kill (red) and which are dead (red skull).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/fcc0567511ca2225683672cfc89e6e57a0837abb.png


- Fixed a bug that made player's not win any more skins.
- Smaller bug fixes

notes.title: Skins & Progressing
notes.content:
This update finally gives you a chance to use your well-spent in-game time in some cool features that will certainly improve your quality time the next time you jump into a match!
Equip yourself as you like and show off to your friends!

Keep up with Death's Playground on the keep up to day on the Official Discord Server.



Skins
As for now, there are only 2 survivor characters and killers were struggling with the recognition of which is who. To counter this effect, skins were added, as well as tons of ways to win them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/98fe92cfd88a74bbc9838b5914f3253b2c1f4bc2.jpg
Jump into the Darkness and check out how you can win your style!


Item Skins
Besides being able to express your style and flex your skins in the Lobbies, item skins were also added so you can enjoy your first-person horrifying scares even harder!

Don't miss out on the super-rare Zippo lighter!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/f35ed0fc631325fd516fd4108093bb2027705cbe.gif



Spend your Money!
Finally there's a way to spend your well-earned Bucks in-game!
The shop is still under construction, but you can buy and equip items before the game starts to get that slight advantage, right off the bat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/c5c0e620b27220e2307b1f4a04a0022579e0fd05.png



Loot Chests
Chests are the best way you have to get your desired skins and, if you are lucky, win the lottery (1,000,000 Bucks)!
You earn Chests every 5 levels as well as 1 for your first game (so you have the chance to escape from the clone matrix of non-customized survivors).
You can also buy Chests if you wish or wait for the Skirmish Rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/4d1a2867934483d0790963a56070a54be154efb5.png



Skirmish
Skirmish is the new system to provide you with rewards as you progress initially!
By earning in-game Experience, you also earn Skirmish Experience. Every level of Skirmish gives you a designated rewards (which you can check out in-game right now!).
Rewards vary between clothes, masks, item skins, items, money and chests!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/c635e9c512119fec3612b83e44bffbae8b0e3e1c.png



Other Important Notes:
- Lots of slight lighting changes and performance improvements;
- Improved AI decision making;
- Improved NPCs map orientation and survivability;
- Improved post-processing performance;
- Changes to Main Menus and overall UI;
- Extended User Experience as well as Ease for Usability;
- A few minor bug fixes and changes!



Future Updates:
There was a lot of feedback on Death's Playground game state and a lot of changes are coming soon!
A new killer is almost ready as well as a new map coming with them, keep up to day on the official  Discord channel.


See you in the Darkness
Kind Regards,
Dipsi

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
Updates:
- Increased killer's speed while being flashed.
- The Shadow can now jumpscare the survivor even in front of them.
- Visual window bug fixed where it clipped through the wall.
- Killer BOT increased smartness and chase capability.
- Fixed a bug that caused snow to affect the killer for too long.
- A basement Easter Egg was being occluded and can now be found!
- Voice Chat increased range and volume.
- Fixed Conjuring's room bed colliders and jumpscare.
- Turned down Xmas Presents volume (soon to be removed from game :c ).


Thank you all for reading :)
See you in the Darkness,
Dipsi

notes.title: Ambience Change
notes.content:
Lots of ambient changes, specially lighting and general game feeling!

Update:
   - Your lighting items will now illuminate your path better.
   - Room lights decently illuminate the room, unless it's a spooky room.
   - DROPPABLE LOCKERS - color change - droppable lockers are now GOLDEN instead of GREY!
   - A small animation was added for when you successfully escape the Mansion!
   - Bots received lots of small fixes and updates!

   - General lighting, sound and performance fixes.


Short Read but Compact <3
Thanks for Reading!
Dipsi

notes.title: Lighting Improvements
notes.content:
Quick Read, but a big Update:
- A lot of lighting improvements and bug fixes. Including shadow pixilation and bugging with intensity flickering.
- General graphics improvements and beauty.
- Post-game lobby bug fixes.
- New Feedback system.
- Increased map awareness.
- Experience rewards now correctly displayed on screen.
- Post-processing effects quality detailing.
- Many small fixes.


Hope you have fun with the Jumpscares :)
Dipsi

notes.title: Spooky Update - Map (NEW!!)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/05efed62e24de7b00501bcd56471804c905696e1.gif

Here it is! The much requested map!

New Survivors have been struggling not to get lost inside the Mansion and many have asked to add a minimap.
As this is a spooky scary game, I didn't want to make things too easy for them!

Here's how it works:
[olist]
Press [M] to bring up the map and try to understand where you are.
Player's don't show up in the map blueprint but you can figure out which way you are going with the compass on the top-right side.
All static objectives are shown in the map besides generators (which spawn in different locations each match).
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/a0c99d6c6af95e84aef0b61f3da6efe665c0b9d1.jpg

Lighting Update
- Reduced lighting on some animations so the players don't glow that much and u can see their scared faces!
- improved light on the killing animation so you can see your heart being ripped out even better!
- General mansion lighting optimizations.
- More eye-flashy lights!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/411f9c40655411deb0f3f9b96d5a6a571c28c849.png

Christmas is over but the Spirit is still here

Jessabelle is still prowling around to hunt you down!

She's sad because she doesn't see her family in many many years. Xmas is over but she decided to lure her prey with some additional stuff:
- Xmas Fire Extinguisher is still here for Survivors to mess around with snow.
- Reduction in number of presents scattered across the map.
- The creepy old clock spawns even less times now.
- Removed a few Xmas decorations.
- Removed the Xmas tree on the lobby.


Tutorial Fixes
- Added a light for easier understanding on where to go after retrieving the video tape (Objective 3).
- Killer tutorial disconnecting fixed.
- Bug preventing killer tutorial from finishing the killer's tutorial after killing the last Survivor alive.


General Bug Fixes
- Possession Jumpscare would sometimes slow Jessabelle longer than it should.
- Bots sometimes failing to work on generators fixed.
- Bots increased lighting capabilities and a cute lighter has been added to them :)
- Incorrect Sound Spatialization fix.
- Bug that sometimes made the killer disconnect after killing all her friends in the lobby.
- Fixed a bug where sometimes a hiding closet would become rigged twice if the killer entered it and scared a player inside.
- Minor bug fixed & tweaks!



Enjoy the Jumpscares!
Let's embrace the spookiness together,
Dipsi

Thank you all for reading and playing the game <3

notes.title: Extended Christmas - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Christmas was extended until I stop seeing snow,
out of my window :)


Xmas Snowball Launcher
- Snowball Launcher is still in the game for you to have fun playing around with the snow (and will still be for a long time)!


Xmas Presents
- Presents are still in the game, but someone has stolen half of them!
- You can still find a few presents throughout the map. Trap them as a killer and Search them as a survivor to get a chance of receiving the Snowball Launcher!


Creepy Old Clock 
- Creepy Old Clock now spawns less times so it doesn't annoy players that much, but it's still present out there.
Take care!


Xmas Lights
- Reduced the number of Xmas lights & overall decorations. Don't worry tho! It still feels like Christmas time!
- Kept the Xmas lights decorations on Objectives so it's easier for people to find and complete them as well as find exit gates easier.


Video Settings
- Added a Reset button to reset your Video Settings.
- Removed Save button and now it saves automatically in every change you make on your Options.


Bug Fixes
- Video Settings were not saving a few options;
- Tutorial objectives updated for a more fluid playthrough;
- Added a few more searchables near the Tutorial's first generator;
- Main Menu Camera was bugging sometimes;
- Particle Texture was disappearing rarely;
- Balancing some numbers on interactions between players, killers and objectives for a better gameplay feeling.
- Smaller bug fixes.


Thanks for your support & feedback,
Have Fun on the Playground for Jumpscares!

Dipsi

notes.title: Death's Playground Xmas Sales - Extra Jumpscares
notes.content:
You are cosy and bored inside your warm house while it's snowing outside: Is there anything better to do than to annoy your friends?

Grab the discount and bring your friends over so you can plot your evil plan to scare them however you wish!

The Xmas Extra Jumpscares Event runs from December 22 - January 15.



What's New?
- Xmas Fire Extinguisher -
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/55986720a0567a3854903349753f5a34371c2ddd.png
Shoots snow all around creating messy pools of snow that make noise whenever anyone walks over them, leaving some footprints afterwards, that melt over time.

This is a great way to know when the killer is approaching as the killer doesn't make any noise while walking, unless they're stepping on some snow.

Creepy Time - If you see footprints coming towards you and there isn't a physical body over them, I advise you to RUN THE HECK OUTTA YOUR STAMINA!



- Christmas Presents -
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/f2c9c474e39d0376023c99ce0570d7b5dea2d059.png
Everyone loves to be surprised on Christmas time with the amazing presents everyone gives to each other. I decided to give you a present as well (actually more than 1)!

Open up every present you find in-game to have a chance to get a good item, a weapon or the Xmas Fire Extinguisher, but be aware! The presents can be trapped by the killer to give you a jumpscare instead!




Snowy Theme
Lots of snow outside and some symbolic winter stuff happening around like snow falling from the sky, Christmas lights & decorations all over the mansion, Christmas trees and hanging lights for a more beautiful season and a creepy clock!

- Map Update -
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/8c6dbd6a7ea7f8768547106c086d9e20062ecd8b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/411f9c40655411deb0f3f9b96d5a6a571c28c849.png

- Objectives Clarity -
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/c4f9952eb107a99efd96cdbdaaee6c47fa0eb927.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/2c3218227540dc81ee7322af09db205aed88b9fb.png

- Escape Doors -
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/2e5ff2b7cffd2c5f47000967ae58fb73efbbfccd.png

- Pay Attention To The Time! -
Be aware of the creepy old clock that spawns behind you and starts playing a distorted Christmas song. Why? No one knows!




Additional Stuff
- XP Boost -
The experience boost will help you to level up your characters faster so, you can try out powerful different combinations of skills to experiment with new playstyles for each character!

- Easter Eggs -
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620626/36c1bca0c6b3898fa38853ca3c508357c124a856.png

A fine new ammount of Easter Eggs, some related to the Christmas season, some others just for the sake of it!
Enjoy finding the newly placed Easter Eggs and try to find out where they are from!
Also, rats are wearing cute Christmas Hats :)





A special thanks for everyone who helped in the development and playtest of this indie game!
I am grateful for all the love and support you are giving me to pursue this crazy adventure to create a scary playground for all you psychos! ;)

Awaiting your feedback <3

notes.title: Playable Tutorial!
Spectator Mode & New-Players Friendly System
notes.content:
Forced a spectator mode in case you want to see your friends die after you!
   - might have a few bugs as it is just a simple prototype.

New features for easier gameplay as survivor for people beginning to understand the game!

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.content:
Smaller bug fixes to improve game's quality:
- Door wasn't opening slowly sometimes.
- Doors sometimes got stuck after locking.
- Double Doors weird behaviour.
- Sound system improvement.
- Piano now has an AI for playing its music while in range!
